name: data-admin
migration_notes: 0005 is additive/forward-only and relies on the existing canonical migrator for one-transaction application, checksum ledger and advisory locking.
0005 folds oldko.account_rate_limits into the canonical stream using IF NOT EXISTS so an existing WS13 table/data is preserved.
The historical WS13 apply-rate-limit command was changed to verification-only; it refuses independent mutation when canonical 0005 is absent.
P2-11 does not apply 0005 to the live target; P2-00/P2-12 must do that after backup and ledger verification.

account_character_lifecycle_evidence.mail_warning: These automated suites use capture/test delivery for token retrieval. They prove account flow semantics, not real production email delivery.

properties: admin identity/session persistence is separate from player account identity
root OWNER role is bound to configured verified root id; forged OWNER role is stripped
online character mutation routes to runtime authority rather than offline SQL mutation
WS28 command becomes SUCCEEDED only after runtime apply proof; pending/unsupported/failure remain distinct
admin_security_evidence.p2_11_extension: oldko.admin_runtime_command_confirmations persists the authoritative applied=true result proof; DB enqueue/update alone cannot satisfy confirmAdminCommand.

new_test_coverage: missing/stale heartbeat cannot report online or fabricated player count
DB-only admin command result cannot be confirmed successful
quest and boss state use optimistic versions
one PostgreSQL character identity joins position/progression/item/quest/clan evidence
fresh PostgreSQL pool sees committed state instead of process-memory authority

verification.note: No target PC/Docker/PostgreSQL executor was available in this workstream session; therefore no test is claimed PASS without runtime evidence.

p2_12_gate: capture backup of the real target DB before 0005
apply only the canonical migrator in rehearsal/approved integration chain
prove rerun is a no-op and checksum mismatch is rejected
interrupt a migration transaction in rehearsal and prove rollback leaves no partial schema/data
p2_13_gate: restart PostgreSQL and all relevant services
prove account login and character selection after restart
prove position/item/quest/progression/clan persistence from one DB
prove normal player credentials cannot authenticate as admin/GM
prove revoked/unauthorized admin access is rejected
prove server status becomes offline/unknown-count when heartbeat goes stale

blockers.detail: coordination/phase2/CHARTER.md, OWNERS.json and CONTRACTS.md were absent at the pinned base. P2-11 published coordination/phase2/P2-11/DEPENDENCY_PROPOSAL.md for P2-00 ratification.

Repository source head before P2-11 is 0004 plus a historical service-owned WS13 rate-limit migration, but the real PC PostgreSQL ledger was not queried and 0005 was intentionally not applied. P2-00/P2-12 must verify/backup/apply.

NullDelivery is fail-closed and test CaptureDelivery is not production delivery. A configured real provider with accepted acknowledgement is required for email verification/password reset production proof; no secret values are stored in this handoff.

Backup/restore, interrupted-transaction rehearsal, full target restart persistence, real runtime admin-result verification and unauthorized-access denial must execute on the composed target before READY_FOR_INTEGRATION can be promoted.
